clue.text: She may be waiting for a job on board ship

definitions.text: She may be waiting for a job on board ship

parts.words: She may be waiting for a job on board ship
parts.note: reads like an unemployed sailor hoping for a berth, but 'waiting' means serving at table, and the woman does it as her job aboard a ship or plane

explanation.surface: A woman hangs about in port hoping to be taken on as crew.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Waiting for a job' suggests job-hunting; in fact waiting is the job itself, serving passengers.
explanation.definitionFit: A cryptic description of a female attendant who serves passengers on a ship or aircraft.

clue.text: Arrogance displayed by group of players

annotationWithheld.why: Arrogance displayed by group of players (4) = SIDE is a plain double definition (arrogance; team), but the check reads the accidental reversed run in 'arrogancE DISplayed' as a hidden word and demands wordplay; no reversal indicator exists, so no honest wordplay parse can be given
annotationWithheld.clue: Arrogance displayed by group of players

clue.text: RAF officer attending former world fair

parts.note: ex- means former, as in ex-wife
PO is Pilot Officer, a junior RAF rank

explanation.surface: An air force officer goes along to a world fair of years gone by.
explanation.definitionFit: An expo is short for exposition, a large international exhibition or world's fair.

clue.text: Soldier hurt in main road on island

indicators.note: in places the word for hurt inside the word for main road

parts.note: an artery is a major traffic route
ill means harmed, as in 'ill effects'
MAN is the Isle of Man, between Britain and Ireland

explanation.surface: A soldier is injured on a main road on an island.
explanation.definitionFit: A gunner in the artillery is a kind of soldier.

clue.text: Attorney is placed over corporation? It's a fact

indicators.note: in a down clue, being placed over means coming first, above the next piece

parts.note: DA is District Attorney, the US prosecutor
corporation is old slang for a pot belly, so a tum

explanation.surface: A lawyer is put in charge of a company, and that is a fact.
explanation.walkthrough: Corporation here is jocular British slang for a large belly, giving TUM.
explanation.definitionFit: A datum is a single given fact or piece of information.

clue.text: Villain cons ruled out of order

indicators.note: out of order signals that the letters of cons and ruled are rearranged

explanation.surface: A villain cons people, and a judge rules him out of order.
explanation.definitionFit: A scoundrel is a dishonest rogue, a synonym for villain.

clue.text: Warrior group's singular claim to be religious

parts.note: a single person claiming to be something says 'I am', shortened to I'M
pi is informal for pious, religious

explanation.surface: A group of warriors claims to be devout.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of 'group's' stands for 'is', a link. An impi is a Zulu regiment.
explanation.definitionFit: An impi is a body of Zulu warriors, so a warrior group.

clue.text: Lying about account, recover evidence of debts

indicators.note: about means going round, so the other pieces surround the abbreviation for account

parts.note: to mend is to recover, get better
IOUs are written acknowledgments of money owed

explanation.surface: Someone lies about their account to recover money owed.
explanation.walkthrough: IOUs are written promises to pay, so 'evidence of debts'; 'about' wraps the recovering and the debts around the account.
explanation.definitionFit: Mendacious means untruthful, given to lying.

clue.text: In the mathematician's line this is excessive

parts.note: an ordinate is the y-coordinate, a line measured on a graph in mathematics

explanation.surface: A mathematician draws a line and finds it is overdoing things.
explanation.definitionFit: Inordinate means beyond proper limits, excessive.

clue.text: Duke with good name throwing out king's envoys

indicators.note: throwing out means removing the letter for king from the word for good name

parts.note: a good name is a reputation
R is rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A duke of high repute dismisses the king's ambassadors.
explanation.walkthrough: R for king comes from Latin rex; 'throwing out' drops it from the good name, leaving EPUTATION to follow the duke.
explanation.definitionFit: A deputation is a group of envoys sent to represent others.

clue.text: Ruin some found overrated

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some ruin has been judged overrated.
explanation.definitionFit: To undo someone is to ruin them, as in 'his pride was his undoing'.

clue.text: Flying bishops about to board plane, for example?

indicators.note: to board means to get on, so these pieces go inside the word for flying

parts.note: aviation is flying aircraft
B is chess notation for bishop, so two make BB
re means about, concerning

explanation.surface: Two airborne bishops are about to board a plane.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to board' puts the bishops and 'about' inside the flying. The definition is witty: 'plane' is itself a shortened word for aeroplane.
explanation.definitionFit: The word plane is a shortened form of aeroplane, an example of a word cut short.

clue.text: Climbing plant latterly grown by GBS

definitions.meaning: a wild clematis with feathery seed-heads
George Bernard Shaw (GBS) grew a long white beard in his later years

explanation.surface: A climber that George Bernard Shaw cultivated late in life.
explanation.walkthrough: GBS is the playwright George Bernard Shaw, famous for his white beard in old age.
explanation.definitionFit: This wild clematis is named for its fluffy white seed-heads; Shaw literally grew one on his chin in old age.

clue.text: Reportedly a type of character destined for variety

indicators.note: reportedly says the words are heard rather than spelt

parts.note: a type of character is 'a sort', destined is 'meant', together 'a sort meant'

explanation.surface: Rumour has it that a particular kind of person was fated for variety shows.
explanation.definitionFit: An assortment is a mixed collection, a variety of things.

clue.text: Intend rite should be replaced? It has been

definitions.text: Intend rite should be replaced? It has been

indicators.note: replaced signals that the letters of intend and rite are put in new places

explanation.surface: Someone wants an old church ceremony replaced, and it already has been.
explanation.walkthrough: 'should be replaced' scrambles the first two words. The whole clue defines: the Tridentine (Latin) Mass was replaced after the Second Vatican Council.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tridentine rite, the old Latin Mass set by the Council of Trent, was superseded in the 1960s.

clue.text: Nominally Tennessee Williams's desire for transport

definitions.meaning: in the Tennessee Williams play, the tram is the vehicle named Desire
a tram, a form of public transport

explanation.surface: The playwright longed for a way of getting around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nominally' points to the title A Streetcar Named Desire: the thing named Desire.
explanation.definitionFit: A streetcar is the American word for a tram, a means of transport.

clue.text: Promising person crossing old college compound

indicators.note: crossing means spanning across, so the word for promising person goes around the college

parts.note: a comer is someone likely to succeed, an up-and-comer
a poly was a polytechnic, a type of British college abolished as a category in 1992

explanation.surface: A promising student crosses the grounds of a former college.
explanation.walkthrough: A poly (polytechnic) was a British higher-education college, renamed as universities in 1992.
explanation.definitionFit: A copolymer is a chemical compound made from two or more kinds of monomer.

clue.text: Wield the sceptre, putting king finally in control

indicators.note: in places the last letter of king inside the word for control

parts.note: a rein is a means of control, as in 'keep a tight rein'

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of king

explanation.surface: A monarch rules by finally putting the king in control.
explanation.definitionFit: To wield the sceptre is to rule as a monarch, which is to reign.

clue.text: Appearing like figs in fridges, strange to say?

definitions.meaning: the letters of figs are the odd-numbered letters of fridges: F, I, G, S
a sentence adverb meaning curiously, surprisingly

explanation.surface: Someone finds it peculiar that figs turn up in refrigerators.
explanation.walkthrough: Fridges spelt out: F-r-I-d-G-e-S; the first, third, fifth and seventh letters spell figs.
explanation.definitionFit: The adverb means strangely or curiously, and also describes letters in odd-numbered positions.

clue.text: Event taking place in European burial chamber

parts.note: a Pole is a person from Poland, a European
a vault is an underground tomb

explanation.surface: Something happens inside a European's crypt.
explanation.definitionFit: The pole vault is an athletics event.

clue.text: One of a cowboy's overheads, it may be felt

definitions.text: One of a cowboy's overheads, it may be felt

parts.words: One of a cowboy's overheads, it may be felt
parts.note: 'overheads' sounds like business costs but means things worn on the head, and 'felt' is the fabric, not the past of feel

explanation.surface: A cowboy feels the pinch of his running costs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Overheads' suggests expenses and 'felt' suggests emotion; both are puns on headwear and its material.
explanation.definitionFit: A large broad-brimmed hat, typically made of felt, worn by cowboys.

clue.text: Minor divinity seen in the spring

definitions.text: Minor divinity seen in the spring

parts.words: Minor divinity seen in the spring
parts.note: suggests a seasonal sighting, but the spring is a water source where a Greek water nymph lives

explanation.surface: A lesser god makes an appearance in springtime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spring' is the water source, not the season.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth this water nymph presides over springs and rivers, a minor deity.

clue.text: Clue you and I read out for apteryx

indicators.note: read out says the words are spoken, so their sound counts

parts.note: a clue is a key, and you and I are we: 'key we'

explanation.surface: A solver reads a clue aloud to a partner, looking for a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Apteryx is the scientific genus name of the flightless New Zealand bird.

clue.text: Radical little woman supported by Left

indicators.note: in a down clue, supported by means sitting on top of the next piece

parts.note: Amy is one of the March sisters in Little Women

explanation.surface: A militant young woman is backed by the political Left.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Radical' in chemistry is a group of atoms; amyl is such a group.
explanation.definitionFit: In chemistry, amyl is a radical, a group of atoms acting as a unit.

clue.text: Put out appeal to back me

indicators.note: back means the word me is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: it means sex appeal, as in 'she's got it'

explanation.surface: Someone issues a plea to support them.
explanation.definitionFit: To emit is to put out or give off, as of light or heat.

clue.text: Locke's theory cracked 6 crimes

indicators.note: cracked means broken up, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: 6 refers to the answer at 6 across, a Zulu warrior group

explanation.surface: A philosopher's theory explains six crimes.
explanation.definitionFit: John Locke founded British empiricism, the theory that knowledge comes from experience.

clue.text: Be prolific, satisfied about income ultimately brought in

indicators.note: brought in places the last letter of income inside the turned word
about means turned round, so the word for satisfied is read backwards

parts.note: met as in 'met the requirements', satisfied

indicators.note: ultimately picks the final letter of income

explanation.surface: A prolific earner is happy about income coming in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns MET into TEM; 'brought in' puts E inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To teem is to abound or be prolific, as in 'teeming with life'.

clue.text: Canny friend entertaining one with simple books

indicators.note: entertaining means holding within, so the friend surrounds the other pieces

parts.note: a pal is a friend
rude in its old sense of primitive or unsophisticated
NT is the New Testament, books of the Bible
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A careful friend hosts someone with plain reading matter.
explanation.definitionFit: Prudential means showing prudence, careful and canny.
